question: What limitless excellence belongs to one for whom knowledge is foremost?
premises: The person is foremost in knowledge.
The person is of an all-virtuous nature.
No end or limit is attributed to such a person.
inference: For one foremost in knowledge and endowed with all virtues, there is no limit to excellence.
plain_english: Thus, for one who is foremost in knowledge and whose nature is all virtues, there is no limit.
